title: Adsorption Information Format (AIF)
description: Dictionary for STAR format adsorption data files.
$comment: Properties are organized into logical sections via 'definitions'. Each section groups related CIF-style data names by prefix. The schema is composed using 'allOf' references so that all section properties are validated together.

x-citation.authors: Evans, J. D.; Bon, V.; Senkovska, I.; Kaskel, S.

audit.$comment: Audit: Version and format tracking. Required for every AIF file.

_audit_aif_version.description: Version of the AIF data-name dictionary used by this file

_audit_author.description: Name of the person who created the data block, if different from the experiment operator.

_audit_creation_date.description: Date and time the AIF file was created in ISO 8601 format

_audit_creation_method.description: The method by which the AIF file was created, e.g. 'manual', 'scripted', 'exported', etc.

_audit_creation_software.description: Name and version of the software used to generate this AIF file

experimental.$comment: Experimental: Conditions, methods, and operator details for the adsorption experiment. These are scalar (single-value) metadata fields that describe the overall experiment.

_exptl_operator.description: Name of the person who performed the experiment or ran the simulation.

_exptl_date.description: Date and time of the experiment in ISO 8601 format

_exptl_instrument.description: Identifier or model name of the instrument used for the measurement

_exptl_temperature.description: Temperature at which the experiment was conducted (see _units_temperature)

_exptl_method.description: Experimental technique used to measure the amount adsorbed
_exptl_method.x-enum-description: Method used to determine amount adsorbed.

_exptl_isotherm_type.description: Classification of the reported adsorbed amount

adsorbent.$comment: Adsorbent / Sample: Identification, physical properties, and degassing conditions for the adsorbent material.

_adsnt_material_name.description: The name of the material, e.g. the common name, CSD refcode, or other standard identifier e.g. UiO-66, Zeolite-13X

_adsnt_info.description: Free-text field for additional information about the adsorbent sample

_adsnt_sample_name.description: Unique sample identifier assigned by the operator or laboratory

_adsnt_hashkey.description: Machine-readable hash key for programmatic identification of the adsorbent

_adsnt_structure_csd_refcode.description: Cambridge Structural Database (CSD) reference code for the adsorbent structure

_adsnt_structure_topology.description: Network topology descriptor (e.g. RCSR symbol) for the adsorbent

_adsnt_structure_smiles.description: SMILES of the organic linker or building block of the adsorbent

_adsnt_composition.description: Chemical composition or formula of the adsorbent, e.g. Cu3(BTC)2

_adsnt_molar_mass.description: Molar mass of the adsorbent formula unit (see _units_molecular_weight)

_adsnt_synthesis.description: Synthesis route or details used, e.g. solvothermal, mechanochemical, reference to MPIF, etc

_adsnt_sample_mass.description: Mass of the adsorbent sample used in the measurement (see _units_mass)

_adsnt_sample_density.description: Bulk or skeletal density of the adsorbent sample (see _units_density)

_adsnt_degas_summary.description: Human-readable summary of the degassing procedure and conditions

_adsnt_degas_temperature.description: Temperature at which the sample was degassed prior to measurement (see _units_temperature)

adsorptive.$comment: Adsorptive: Physical and chemical identifiers and properties of the adsorptive molecule.

_adsorptive_name.description: The common or IUPAC name of the gas/vapour used as adsorptive in the experiment or simulation e.g. Nitrogen, CO2, Water

_adsorptive_info.description: Alternative or secondary name for the adsorptive, e.g. chemical formula or abbreviation

_adsorptive_inchi.description: IUPAC InChI identifier of the adsorptive

_adsorptive_cas.description: CAS Registry Number of the adsorptive

_adsorptive_smiles.description: Canonical SMILES string of the adsorptive

_adsorptive_component_index.description: Index for an adsorptive component in a mixture. Required field for mixtures.

_adsorptive_component_name.description: The common or IUPAC name of an adsorptive component in a mixture, e.g. Nitrogen, CO2, Water

_adsorptive_component_info.description: Alternative or secondary name for an adsorptive component in a mixture, e.g. chemical formula or abbreviation

_adsorptive_component_inchi.description: IUPAC InChI identifier of an adsorptive component in a mixture

_adsorptive_component_cas.description: CAS Registry Number of an adsorptive component in a mixture

_adsorptive_component_smiles.description: Canonical SMILES string of an adsorptive component in a mixture

_adsorptive_component_formula.description: Chemical formula of an adsorptive component in a mixture

simulation.$comment: Simulation: Computational method details for simulated isotherms (e.g. GCMC, MD). Only relevant when the data originates from molecular simulation rather than experiment. Requires _exptl_method = simulation.

_simltn_code.description: Name and version of the simulation software, e.g. RASPA 2.0, LAMMPS

_simltn_size.description: Description of the simulated system size, e.g. number of unit cells or particle count

_simltn_forcefield_adsorptive.description: Force field or interaction model used for the adsorptive, e.g. TraPPE, OPLS-AA

_simltn_forcefield_adsorbent.description: Force field or interaction model used for the adsorbent framework, e.g. UFF, DREIDING

_simltn_input_files.description: URL or repository link to the simulation input files and scripts

_simltn_sampling.description: Phase-space sampling method used, e.g. GCMC, MD, Widom insertion

_simltn_lot.description: Level of theory for the calculation, e.g. DFT, machine-learned potential, classical force field

_simltn_date.description: Date and time of the simulation in ISO 8601 format. This field is deprecated and may be removed in future versions of the AIF schema.

digitization.$comment: Digitization: Metadata relevant when file data were extracted/reconstructed from a static image of a published figure or table, rather than recorded directly from an instrument or simulation output. Presence of any field in this section implies the data were digitized; the underlying experimental or simulation method is still recorded via _exptl_method regardless.

_digitization_author.description: Name of the person who digitized the data from the published figure or table

_digitization_date.description: Date when the data were digitized from the published figure or table in ISO 8601 format.

_digitization_method.description: The decision making method in validating the data: solely by a human (human), with ML/AI assistance or AI with human review (AI-aided), or fully automated via ML/AI without human intervention (AI-automated).
_digitization_method.x-enum-description: Method of data extraction from a source figure.

x-enum-descriptions.human: Data extracted solely by a human. This does not exclude the use of software tools but indicates that data selection decisions were made exclusively by a human person.
x-enum-descriptions.AI-aided: Data extracted in part using machine learning or AI tools, in cooperation with or verified by a human person.
x-enum-descriptions.AI-automated: Data extracted automatically from a figure via machine learning or AI tools, without human intervention.

_digitization_software.description: Name and version of the software or tool used to digitize the data, e.g. WebPlotDigitizer 4.6, Engauge Digitizer, or 'manual' for pixel-by-pixel manual measurement. This field must be present when _digitization_method is either AI-aided or AI-automated.

_digitization_notes.description: Free-text field for any additional notes about the digitization process or source, like assumptions, limitations, data identification (e.g. which curve was digitized), or any other relevant information.

citation.$comment: Citation: Bibliographic reference for the source publication or dataset.

_citation_doi.description: Digital Object Identifier (DOI) of the publication associated with this data

_citation_source.description: Bibliographic source or full citation of the data, e.g. journal name, book title, or database

_citation_figure.description: Identifier of the figure or table within the original publication, e.g. Figure 3b, Table S2

_citation_page.description: Page number or supplementary-information identifier of the original publication, e.g. 145, S12

_citation_url.description: URL or persistent link to the source of the publication, data, figure or table, if available.

units.$comment: Units: Measurement unit definitions for all numerical quantities. These scalar fields declare the units used throughout the file so that data columns can be interpreted correctly. The units are recommended to follow the QUDT ontology (http://qudt.org/) or other standard ontologies.

_units_temperature.description: Unit of temperature for all temperature values in this file, e.g. K, °C

_units_pressure.description: Unit of pressure for all pressure values in this file, e.g. kPa, bar, mmHg

_units_mass.description: Unit of mass for all mass values in this file, e.g. g, mg, kg

_units_sorbed_amount.description: Unit of amount adsorbed for all loading values in this file, e.g. mmol/g, cm3(STP)/g, wt%

_units_density.description: Unit of density for all density values in this file, e.g. g/cm3, kg/m3

_units_time.description: Unit of time for all time values in this file, e.g. s, min, hours

_units_molecular_weight.description: Unit of molecular weight values in this file, e.g. g/mol

_units_enthalpy.description: Unit of enthalpy values in this file, e.g. kJ/mol

_units_composition_type.description: Definition of how mixture compositions are expressed, e.g. mole_fraction, mass_fraction, partial_pressure, relative_humidity, concentration

adsorption_data.$comment: Adsorption Data: Loop columns for the adsorption branch of the isotherm. These fields appear inside a STAR loop_ construct, with one row per equilibrium point.

_adsorp_index.description: Index of the adsorption data point, starting from 1 and incrementing by 1 for each point.

_adsorp_pressure.description: Equilibrium pressure at each adsorption data point (see _units_pressure)

_adsorp_fugacity.description: Fugacity of the adsorptive at each adsorption data point (see _units_pressure)

_adsorp_p0.description: Saturation pressure at each adsorption data point, for use in relative pressure calculations (see _units_pressure)

_adsorp_amount.description: Loading at each adsorption data point (see _units_sorbed_amount). Key is used as total loading in a multicomponent setting.

_adsorp_amount_excess.description: Excess loading at each adsorption data point (see _units_sorbed_amount). Key is used as total loading in a multicomponent setting.

_adsorp_amount_absolute.description: Absolute loading at each adsorption data point (see _units_sorbed_amount). Key is used as total loading in a multicomponent setting.

_adsorp_amount_net.description: Net loading at each adsorption data point (see _units_sorbed_amount)

_adsorp_fugacity_component_1.description: Fugacity of first adsorptive component in the bulk phase at each adsorption measurement (see _units_pressure)

_adsorp_fugacity_component_2.description: Fugacity of second adsorptive component in the bulk phase at each adsorption measurement (see _units_pressure)

_adsorp_fugacity_component_3.description: Fugacity of third adsorptive component in the bulk phase at each adsorption measurement (see _units_pressure)

_adsorp_fugacity_component_9.description: Fugacity of ninth adsorptive component in the bulk phase at each adsorption measurement (see _units_pressure)

_adsorp_fugacity_component_10.description: Fugacity of tenth adsorptive component in the bulk phase at each adsorption measurement (see _units_pressure)

_adsorp_composition_component_1.description: Mole fraction of the first component in the bulk phase at each adsorption measurement (see _units_composition_type)

_adsorp_composition_component_2.description: Mole fraction of the second component in the bulk phase at each adsorption measurement (see _units_composition_type)

_adsorp_composition_component_3.description: Mole fraction of the third component in the bulk phase at each adsorption measurement (see _units_composition_type)

_adsorp_composition_component_6.description: Mole fraction of the sixth component in the bulk phase at each adsorption measurement (see _units_composition_type)

_adsorp_composition_component_7.description: Mole fraction of the seventh component in the bulk phase at each adsorption measurement (see _units_composition_type)

_adsorp_composition_component_8.description: Mole fraction of the eighth component in the bulk phase at each adsorption measurement (see _units_composition_type)

_adsorp_composition_component_9.description: Mole fraction of the ninth component in the bulk phase at each adsorption measurement (see _units_composition_type)

_adsorp_composition_component_10.description: Mole fraction of the tenth component in the bulk phase at each adsorption measurement (see _units_composition_type)

_adsorp_amount_component_1.description: Sorptive loading of the first component in the adsorbed phase for a multicomponent adsorption measurement (see _units_sorbed_amount)

_adsorp_amount_component_2.description: Sorptive loading of the second component in the adsorbed phase for a multicomponent adsorption measurement (see _units_sorbed_amount)
